discardChanges.bodyEdited: Everything on this computer that has not been uploaded to SpeleoDB will be thrown away, and this project replaced with the latest version from the server.
discardChanges.lockQuestion: Keep the write lock to carry on editing from the latest version, or release it so someone else can.
discardChanges.doneKeptToast: Back at the latest version from SpeleoDB, and you still hold the write lock.
discardChanges.doneReleasedToast: Back at the latest version from SpeleoDB, and the write lock is released.
discardChanges.failedTitle: Could not get the latest version
discardChanges.failedMessage: The local copy was left as it was.

undoMode.title: Undo history in SpeleoDB
undoMode.description: Whether this project's edit history is stored with each revision, so undo can continue past a commit. It is a project setting: it travels with the file, so it applies to everyone who edits this project once pushed.
undoMode.fullHint: Each revision stores the operations that produced it, so undo reaches back through the project's whole history.
undoMode.disabledHint: Undo works locally but is stripped before every push. For very large projects, where storing whole-survey snapshots in each revision is not worth the repository growth.
undoMode.lockRequired: Start editing to change this - it is stored in the project file and applies to everyone once pushed.
undoMode.failed: Could not change the undo-history setting.

revert.awaitingChoice: Revision {{sha}} holds more than one openable file, so the write lock was handed back while you choose. Nothing was changed. Pick a file and the revert runs again from the start.
revert.title: Revert to revision {{sha}}
revert.body: This takes the write lock on "{{name}}", replaces the working copy with revision {{sha}}, uploads it as a new revision, and releases the write lock again.
revert.consequence: Your project history is not rewritten - the revert lands as a new revision on top of the current one. When it finishes the project is read-only again, exactly as it is now.
revert.unsavedWarning: You have changes that are not saved to disk. Save or discard them first - a revert replaces the working copy, so it cannot keep them.
revert.unpushedWarning: This copy has changes that are not on SpeleoDB. A revert replaces them, and they are not on the server, so this cannot be undone.

steps.restoring: Replacing the working copy with revision {{sha}}…
steps.pushing: Uploading the revert and releasing the write lock…

revert.done: Reverted to revision {{sha}} and released the write lock.

errors.locked: Could not take the write lock: {{email}} is editing this project. Nothing was changed.
errors.lockFailed: Could not take the write lock on SpeleoDB, so nothing was changed.
errors.unsavedLocal: Nothing was changed: this project has changes that are not saved to disk. Save or discard them first - a revert replaces the working copy, and unsaved changes are nowhere else.
errors.restoreFailed: The write lock was released and nothing was changed.
errors.restoreFailedLockHeld: You still hold the write lock, because this copy has changes that are not on SpeleoDB.
errors.lockStillHeld: The write lock was kept, because releasing it would leave your unpushed changes unprotected.
errors.pushFailed: Revision {{sha}} is in your working copy and you still hold the write lock, but it could not be uploaded. That upload is all that is left, so retry it below.
errors.pushUnconfirmed: The upload could not be confirmed, so the revert may or may not have reached SpeleoDB. Your working copy and the write lock are both kept, so retry it below - a revert that did land is recognised as yours rather than uploaded a second time.
errors.notEditing: Revision {{sha}} is in your working copy, but your SpeleoDB session ended before it could be uploaded, so nothing was published and no write lock is held. Close this dialog, connect to SpeleoDB again, then start editing to upload it.

toasts.editing: You now hold the write lock - editing enabled.
toasts.lockedBy: Could not take the write lock right now - the project is being edited by {{email}}. Please try again later.
toasts.released: Changes uploaded and the write lock released.
toasts.releasedNothingToUpload: Write lock released. Nothing to upload.
toasts.pushedWithoutHistory: Changes pushed without undo history: the project is over the SpeleoDB size limit.
toasts.releasedWithoutHistory: Changes uploaded without undo history (the project is over the SpeleoDB size limit) and the write lock released.
toasts.takeRemoteFailed: Could not take the SpeleoDB version
toasts.notEditing: Nothing was uploaded - you are not editing this project right now. Start editing again (connecting to SpeleoDB first if needed) to upload your changes.
toasts.lateUploadFailed: The upload you left running did not reach SpeleoDB. Your changes are still on this computer.

done.title: Finish editing
done.description: Upload your changes to SpeleoDB and release the write lock.
done.pushDescription: Upload your changes to SpeleoDB and keep the write lock so you can carry on editing.
done.retryHint: They are still only on this computer. Fix the problem, then press the button again to retry.

errors.body: Uploading sends the survey to SpeleoDB as it is, errors included. Fix them first, or confirm that they should be uploaded.
errors.confirmBlocked: The survey has errors. Fix them, or tick "Upload anyway" to upload them as they are.

commitMessage.tooLong: This description is too long for SpeleoDB ({{length}} characters). Shorten it to {{max}} characters or fewer. Each line break counts as two characters.

noPermission.title: No SpeleoDB access
noPermission.description: This project is linked to SpeleoDB, but your account doesn't have permission to view or edit it - it may have been shared with you as a file. You can convert it to a regular, unmanaged .stalx file to keep and edit locally.

managedFile.title: This file is managed by SpeleoDB
managedFile.message: "{{fileName}}" is a copy of the SpeleoDB project "{{name}}". A managed project has one working copy on this computer, so this file cannot be opened directly.
managedFile.hint: Open the project from SpeleoDB to work on the managed copy, or remove this file's SpeleoDB link to open it as an independent local project. Removing the link changes only this file - the SpeleoDB project is untouched.
managedFile.openRemoteDisabledLoggedOut: Connect to SpeleoDB to open the managed copy. Removing the link works offline.
managedFile.openRemoteDisabledBadId: This file's SpeleoDB project id is not readable, so it cannot be opened from the server.
managedFile.removeFailed: Could not remove the SpeleoDB link
managedFile.notOnAccount: "{{name}}" is not available on your SpeleoDB account.
managedFile.endpointMismatch: This file is linked to {{endpoint}}, which is not the server you are connected to.
managedFile.copySaved: Saved an unlinked copy to {{path}}. You are still working on the SpeleoDB-managed project.

unpushedLocal.choices: "Open my local copy" opens the copy on this computer as it is, without downloading anything. You can then upload your changes, and Stalagmight will tell you if SpeleoDB has a newer version. "Discard my changes" deletes them and opens the version on SpeleoDB instead. Cancel leaves them as they are.
unpushedLocal.title: Changes on this computer are not on SpeleoDB
unpushedLocal.message: "{{name}}" has already been opened on this computer, and that local copy has changes SpeleoDB has never seen. Replacing the local copy would delete them, so your local changes have been left intact.
unpushedLocal.lastEditedUnknown: We could not tell when the local copy was last edited.
unpushedLocal.discardWarning: Discarding permanently deletes the changes made to "{{name}}" on this computer. They are not on SpeleoDB, so there is no other copy and this cannot be undone.
unpushedLocal.messageOtherAccount: "{{name}}" has already been opened on this computer by {{owner}}, and that local copy holds changes {{owner}} made that SpeleoDB has never seen. They are {{owner}}'s work, not yours, so they have been left intact.
unpushedLocal.choicesOtherAccount: "Open it read-only" opens the copy on this computer as it is, without downloading anything and without taking the editing lock. You can look at {{owner}}'s changes and save a copy of the project, but only {{owner}} can edit and upload them. "Discard their changes" deletes them and opens the version on SpeleoDB instead. Cancel leaves them as they are.

remove.unknown: Stalagmight could not read this copy, so it may hold changes that were never uploaded to SpeleoDB. Removing it may delete them for good.

quitWait.forceBody: The transfer will be cut off, and SpeleoDB may or may not receive it.

quitWait.saveFailed: Your changes could not be saved on this computer, so Stalagmight did not quit.

speleoExitPrompt.title: Your changes are not on SpeleoDB yet
speleoExitPrompt.body: You are editing "{{name}}", and some of your changes have not been uploaded to SpeleoDB. What should happen to them before {{action}}?
speleoExitPrompt.choices: Upload sends them to SpeleoDB and hands the project back, so others can edit it. Keep the lock leaves them on this computer and keeps the project reserved for you, so nobody else can edit it until you come back and upload. Discard throws them away and hands the project back.
speleoExitPrompt.uploadBody: Describe what you changed. Other cavers will see this note in the project history.
speleoExitPrompt.messagePlaceholder: For example: surveyed the north passage
speleoExitPrompt.uploadProgressBody: This can take a moment for a large survey.
speleoExitPrompt.uploadSlow: The upload is taking more than 2 minutes. It may still finish. You can wait, or close this window and try again later.
speleoExitPrompt.olderVersion: This copy is an older version of the survey that you went back to. Uploading it records that older version over the newer one, for everyone who works on this project.
speleoExitPrompt.discardBody: Your changes will be lost forever.
speleoExitPrompt.discardDetail: The changes on this computer that are not on SpeleoDB will be deleted, and the project will be handed back. Next time you open it, you will get the version that is on SpeleoDB.

signOut.intro: Disconnecting hands back every project you are editing on SpeleoDB, so others can edit them.
signOut.checkFailedBody: SpeleoDB could not be reached, so Stalagmight cannot tell which projects you are editing. If you disconnect anyway, any project you are editing stays reserved for you until you connect again and hand it back. Changes on this computer are kept.
signOut.openProjectBody: "{{name}}", the project you have open, has changes that are not on SpeleoDB yet. Upload them before you disconnect, keep them on this computer to upload after you connect again, or discard them.
signOut.otherChangesBody: These projects have changes that are not on SpeleoDB yet. The changes stay on this computer, and you can open and upload them after you connect again:

signOut.discardDetail: They are deleted from this computer, and the project is handed back. Next time you open it, you will get the version that is on SpeleoDB.
signOut.discardOthersKept: Only this project is affected: the other projects keep their changes on this computer.
signOut.discardFailed: The changes to "{{name}}" could not be discarded.

signOut.signOutAnywayHint: If you disconnect anyway, these projects stay reserved for you, and nobody else can edit them until you connect again and hand them back.

speleoReleaseFailed.title: Couldn't hand back the lock
speleoReleaseFailed.body: Stalagmight could not hand back the SpeleoDB lock on "{{name}}" before {{action}}. Until it is handed back, nobody else can edit the project.
speleoReleaseFailed.choices: Retry asks SpeleoDB again and hands the lock back if it is still yours. Close and keep the lock leaves the project reserved for you: the next time you connect to SpeleoDB, Stalagmight offers to release it, and you can also release it on the SpeleoDB website. Cancel keeps the project open, read-only until you resume editing.
